hotel_1star_semantic.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Mexico City? Hotel Prices for Mexico City, Mexico | Budget Your Trip
hotel_1star_semantic.evidenceText: The mandated search returned the exact Mexico City BudgetYourTrip hotel page and its search result exposed an Average 1-Star Hotel Price of $51 based on 11 hotels. The single mandated page read returned HTTP 429 Too Many Requests, so the same-page occupancy, unit, and tax semantics could not be inspected.
hotel_1star_semantic.referencePeriod: Search result crawled 2 weeks before retrieval; mandated page read attempted 2026-08-01 and blocked by HTTP 429.
